## berth backup create

encrypted backup of orgs (age key, recipients, or a gpg passphrase)

### Synopsis

encrypted backup of orgs (age key, recipients, or a gpg passphrase)

Docs: https://ar4mirez.github.io/berth/reference/commands/berth_backup_create/

```
berth backup create <org>...|--all [--plan] [-o file|dir|-] [--passphrase | -r <key> | --no-encrypt] [--keep N] [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  berth backup create acme
  berth backup create --all --keep 14
  berth backup create acme -o - > acme.tar.zst.age
```
